patterns.note: Alternating full-width dark gray and bright yellow background sections create distinct visual breaks and energy throughout the page.
A single, heavy sans-serif font family is used across all text, with significant variations in weight and size to establish a clear hierarchy from massive headings to legible body text.
A high-contrast primary palette of dark gray, bright yellow, and white is consistently applied, with vibrant social media brand colors used as secondary accents for icons and links.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scroll experience.
A massive, fixed background text element ('Colin & Samir') is revealed at the very bottom of the page as the user scrolls, acting as a dramatic visual anchor and brand statement.
Content offerings are presented in distinct, visually separated card-like blocks, each with a clear title, descriptive text, and a prominent 'Learn More' call-to-action.

technique_notes: Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they scroll into view, likely orchestrated using GSAP ScrollTrigger to coordinate entry animations.
A large, fixed background text element is positioned at the bottom of the page, revealing itself dramatically as the user scrolls down, creating a strong brand statement and visual anchor.
The layout alternates between full-width dark gray and bright yellow background sections to create clear visual separation and energy, with content typically centered within a contained width.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, heavy sans-serif headings (up to ~6x body text) with smaller, legible body text and uppercase labels for CTAs.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and card-like elements (e.g., 8-12px).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between main sections and within the hero, but tighter spacing for content cards.

standout: The most distinctive element is the massive, fixed 'Colin & Samir' text that dramatically reveals itself at the bottom of the page as a user scrolls, creating a powerful, memorable brand statement. This, combined with the bold yellow and dark gray color scheme, gives the site a unique, energetic personality.
